_comment: Used only together with prev-pinned-unresolved.json and flake.lock, to prove that a prev
freeze wins over semver resolution before any ls-remote happens (checks.resolve-semver step
13(b)). The url is a fixed, nonexistent path -- if the freeze did not win and semver resolution
ran anyway, ls-remote against this url would fail and the check would fail loudly instead of
silently passing for the wrong reason.
